title: Restricting a local assignment
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$, and let an assignment give a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each of $r+K$ coordinates. Its restriction to the local prefix of size $r+a$ assigns to each coordinate the sign at its image under the local-prefix embedding.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of signs to $r+K$ coordinates
